usage: tunnel recordings ls [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--session NAME]
                            [--key KEY] [--host HOST]

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --base BASE     where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json          print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --session NAME  only this session (default: all)
  --key KEY       only this rule key, e.g. GET:api.example.com/api/feed
  --host HOST     only this host; * is a wildcard
